sources.observed_excerpt: UPS n=3, GIST n=5, Liposarcoma n=4, Leiomyosarcoma n=2, MPNST n=1
sources.finding: Flow: 15 patient-derived cultures of those histologies plus HT1080 fibrosarcoma. RNA: 251 TCGA samples (LMS99, DDLPS58, UPS/MFH/high-grade spindle50, MFS25, MPNST9, synovial10). No EMC in either disclosed cohort.
sources.completeness: Disclosed cohorts inspected; supplements not inspected.

sources.observed_excerpt: NG2 was predominantly associated with the tumour cells (as well as decorating pericytes of the neovasculature)
sources.finding: Figure 1 lists MFH-like pleomorphic sarcoma, LMS, liposarcoma variants, fibrosarcoma, synovial sarcoma. NG2 immunolabeling on neoplastic cells and neovasculature; Figure 2 identifies pericyte staining within NG2-negative tumor-cell xenografts. Supports possible perivascular contribution in other sarcomas, not EMC cell origin.
sources.completeness: Supplementary Table S1 NOT inspected. Full count and exhaustive subtype scope unverified; no inference that EMC is absent.

sources.observed_excerpt: 343 cancer cell lines including four sarcoma cell lines
sources.finding: 1,378 pooled bulk-RNA clinical specimens; Table 1 groups 177 as other. Separate cancer-cell-line RNA/protein correlation does not establish EMC tissue protein.
sources.completeness: Other subtype breakdown NOT inspected; EMC inclusion/exclusion not inferred.

sources.finding: Sarcoma evidence comes from expression databases; disclosed IHC series concerns melanoma, breast cancer, HNSCC, neuroblastoma, mesothelioma. No verified EMC protein.
